issue: तुम वियोग अति व्याकुलयारी: व्याकुलयारी is not a known word (the book and Drik Panchang both print it). Read as व्याकुल + यारी (Persian yārī, 'help, aid'): 'the help of the sorely distressed'; the half then has no verb.
our reading: A woman parted from her husband is in great distress; you are the help of those sorely distressed by separation.
alternatives: व्याकुलहारी, 'remover of distress' (one letter); or यारी as 'friend'.

issue: तापे करहिं कृपा जगदीशा: जगदीशा may be the Lord of the world (Jagadīśa, with the rhyme's ā) or the Mother herself as Jagadīśā, 'mistress of the world'.
our reading: the Lord of the world (जगदीश) bestows grace.
alternatives: the Mother, as ruler of the world, bestows grace.
